problem_meta.question: Does endometriosis also affect the decidua in contact with the fetal membranes during pregnancy?

contexts: Are the fetal membranes of women affected with endometriosis similar to those from disease-free women?

problem_meta.long_answer: Decidua of women with endometriosis is able to generate endometriotic-like lesions in contact with the fetal membranes.
